description: Checkpoint redacted GroundLine activity across short, long-lived, resumed, compacted, and closed root Codex work.

hooks.command: g=''; case "$(uname -s 2>/dev/null):$(uname -m 2>/dev/null)" in Darwin:arm64) g='aarch64-apple-darwin';; Darwin:x86_64) g='x86_64-apple-darwin';; Linux:aarch64|Linux:arm64) g='aarch64-unknown-linux-musl';; Linux:x86_64|Linux:amd64) g='x86_64-unknown-linux-musl';; esac; if [ -n "$g" ] && [ -x "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/$g/groundline-insights" ]; then "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/$g/groundline-insights" checkpoint session_start_hook --plugin-root "${PLUGIN_ROOT}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; exit 0
hooks.commandWindows: if /I "%PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE%"=="ARM64" (if exist "%PLUGIN_ROOT%\bin\aarch64-pc-windows-msvc\groundline-insights.exe" ("%PLUGIN_ROOT%\bin\aarch64-pc-windows-msvc\groundline-insights.exe" checkpoint session_start_hook --plugin-root "%PLUGIN_ROOT%" >nul 2>&1)) else (if exist "%PLUGIN_ROOT%\bin\x86_64-pc-windows-msvc\groundline-insights.exe" ("%PLUGIN_ROOT%\bin\x86_64-pc-windows-msvc\groundline-insights.exe" checkpoint session_start_hook --plugin-root "%PLUGIN_ROOT%" >nul 2>&1)) & exit /b 0
